inlines.v: PERPETU'ITY, noun [Latin perpetuitas.] Endless duration; continuance to eternity. 1. Continued uninterrupted existence, or duration for an indefinite period of time; as the perpetuity of laws and institutions; the perpetuity of fame. 2. Something of which there will be no end.
